note: The IEOM's observatory of bank charges in the French Pacific (prices at 1 April 2026), New Caledonia's table: the yearly price, in CFP francs, of each bank's international deferred-debit card, whose month's spending the bank takes from the account at once, so nothing is carried on it. The OPT, the post office's bank, offers none. The banks' revolving credit isn't in the table and isn't kept. The Banque de Nouvelle-Calédonie's own price list for private customers (in force from 1 April 2026), read 30 October 2026, gives its full range of cards that can be taken with deferred debit: the Visa Classic (5,373 francs a year, the observatory's figure), Visa Premier (19,851) and Visa Infinite (42,705), each written as charged in full; card payments outside the euro zone carry a 2.56% commission, written as the foreign transaction share (payments in euros in the euro zone cost nothing, which isn't modelled).
